name: Children Education Allowance
benefit: - **Financial assistance of ₹500/- per child, per month, for up to two children.**
_eligibility_text: 1. The worker should be engaged in building or construction work. 1. The worker should be registered with the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board. 1. The worker’s child should be studying between Nursery and 10th Class. 1. A maximum of two children per family are eligible.
